# Agriyon

> > Agriyon is a guided discovery platform covering gaming strategies, esports mechanics, and agricultural entrepreneurship through comprehensive tutorials and meta analysis.

Agriyon combines two distinct content verticals: in-depth gaming guides covering competitive and single-player titles with detailed mechanical breakdowns, and agricultural business resources focused on sustainable and profitable farming practices. The platform uses guided questionnaires to help users discover relevant content across both domains.

## Key Topics

- Game Strategy & Mechanics
- Ranked Gameplay
- Esports Meta
- Gaming Guides
- Video Game Mechanics
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Agricultural Entrepreneurship
- Farming Business Models
- Carbon Farming
- Value Addition
- Competitive Gaming
- Game Tutorials
- Guided Discovery
- Forza Horizon 5
- Baldur's Gate 3
- League of Legends
